summary_en: OHASHI TECHNICA authorized acquisition of up to 500,000 shares (1.9% of outstanding shares) for up to ¥550 million through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 12, 2026 to March 31, 2027, targeting shareholder returns and capital efficiency improvement.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 11, 2026, OHASHI TECHNICA's Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of up to 500,000 treasury shares, representing 1.9% of outstanding shares (25.7 million shares excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026), for an aggregate purchase price not exceeding ¥550 million. The company will execute the acquisition through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 12, 2026 and March 31, 2027. The implicit ceiling price is approximately ¥1,100 per share.

The company states that the acquisition aims to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency. The authorization is granted pursuant to the Company Law Article 165, paragraph 3, read in conjunction with Article 156.
